name: Angular Removed-API Lint rule set

levels.error: Removed from Angular — does not compile on a current major.
levels.warning: Deprecated — still works, scheduled to stop working.
levels.info: Supported, but the NgModule-era form the current schematics no longer emit.

policy: Angular supports each major release for 18 months: 6 months active support, then 12 months long-term support (LTS). Dates below are the release date and release + 18 months.

rules.msg: Angular version pin found.
rules.fix: Upgrade one major at a time with `ng update @angular/core@N @angular/cli@N`.

rules.msg: The `@angular/http` package was removed in Angular 8.
rules.fix: Import `HttpClient` from `@angular/common/http` and register it with `provideHttpClient()`.

rules.msg: `Renderer` (the v1 renderer) was removed in Angular 9.
rules.fix: Inject `Renderer2` instead; `setProperty`/`setAttribute`/`listen` replace the old methods.

rules.msg: This imports a private Angular symbol (the `ɵ` prefix marks compiler internals).
rules.fix: Private symbols carry no compatibility guarantee and change without notice — use the public API or vendor the behaviour.

rules.msg: `ModuleWithProviders` without a type argument stopped compiling in Angular 10.
rules.fix: Write `ModuleWithProviders<YourModule>`.

rules.msg: The `async()` test helper was removed in Angular 12 (it collided with the `async` keyword).
rules.fix: Import and call `waitForAsync()` instead — same behaviour, new name.

rules.msg: `entryComponents` was removed in Angular 13.
rules.fix: Delete the property — Ivy resolves dynamically created components without it.

rules.msg: `TestBed.get()` was removed in Angular 13 (deprecated in 9).
rules.fix: Use `TestBed.inject(Token)` — it is typed, so the cast you probably wrote can go too.

rules.msg: `InjectFlags` has been deprecated since Angular 14.
rules.fix: Pass an options object instead: `inject(TOKEN, { optional: true, skipSelf: true })`.

rules.msg: Class-based router guards and resolvers have been deprecated since Angular 15.2.
rules.fix: Export a function instead: `export const canActivateFoo: CanActivateFn = () => inject(Auth).ok();`.

rules.msg: The `canLoad` route property has been deprecated since Angular 15.1.
rules.fix: Use `canMatch` — it also runs for already-loaded routes, which is what most `canLoad` guards meant.

rules.msg: `RouterLinkWithHref` was folded into `RouterLink` in Angular 15.
rules.fix: Import `RouterLink`; it handles anchors and non-anchor elements alike.

rules.msg: `@angular/flex-layout` was retired by the Angular team and receives no further releases.
rules.fix: Replace the directives with CSS grid or flexbox, or with the community fork you vendor yourself.

rules.msg: `BrowserModule.withServerTransition()` has been deprecated since Angular 16.
rules.fix: Set `APP_ID` as a provider instead; the transition id is read from it.

rules.msg: The `enableIvy` compiler flag was removed in Angular 16 — View Engine no longer exists.
rules.fix: Delete the flag from `angularCompilerOptions` in tsconfig.json.

rules.msg: `ngcc` (the View Engine compatibility compiler) was removed in Angular 16.
rules.fix: Delete the ngcc postinstall script; every published library is Ivy now.

rules.msg: The router option `relativeLinkResolution` was removed in Angular 16.
rules.fix: Delete it — the `corrected` behaviour it selected is now the only behaviour.

rules.msg: `toPromise()` is deprecated in RxJS 7, the version Angular has shipped since 16, and is gone in RxJS 8.
rules.fix: Use `firstValueFrom(obs$)` or `lastValueFrom(obs$)` — they throw on empty instead of resolving `undefined`.

rules.msg: `RouterModule.forRoot()` is the NgModule route setup; standalone bootstrap has been the documented default since Angular 17.
rules.fix: Move the routes to `provideRouter(routes)` inside `bootstrapApplication(App, { providers: [...] })`.

rules.msg: Built-in control flow has been stable since Angular 17 and is what the current docs and schematics emit.
rules.fix: Run `ng generate @angular/core:control-flow` to rewrite `*ngIf`/`*ngFor`/`*ngSwitch` as `@if`/`@for`/`@switch`.

rules.msg: `BrowserAnimationsModule` is the NgModule form of the animations setup.
rules.fix: Use `provideAnimationsAsync()` (or `provideAnimations()`) in the bootstrap providers.

rules.msg: `platformBrowserDynamic().bootstrapModule()` is the NgModule bootstrap path.
rules.fix: Use `bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, appConfig)` from `@angular/platform-browser`.

rules.msg: `HttpClientModule` has been deprecated since Angular 18.
rules.fix: Call `provideHttpClient()` in your bootstrap providers; add `withInterceptors([...])` for interceptors.

rules.msg: `HttpClientTestingModule` has been deprecated since Angular 18.
rules.fix: Use `provideHttpClient()` plus `provideHttpClientTesting()` in the testing providers.

rules.msg: The `APP_INITIALIZER` token has been deprecated since Angular 19.
rules.fix: Use `provideAppInitializer(() => inject(Config).load())` — no multi-provider boilerplate.

rules.msg: The `ENVIRONMENT_INITIALIZER` token has been deprecated since Angular 19.
rules.fix: Use `provideEnvironmentInitializer(() => { ... })`.

rules.msg: `AfterRenderPhase` has been deprecated since Angular 19.
rules.fix: Pass a phase-keyed object instead: `afterRender({ write: () => { ... } })`.

rules.msg: `ExperimentalPendingTasks` was renamed in Angular 19.
rules.fix: Import `PendingTasks` from `@angular/core`; the API is unchanged.

rules.msg: The `allowSignalWrites` option on `effect()` was deprecated in Angular 19 and does nothing.
rules.fix: Delete the option — effects may write to signals without it.

rules.msg: `standalone: true` has been the default since Angular 19, so writing it is redundant.
rules.fix: Delete the property. Only `standalone: false` carries meaning now (a component still declared in an NgModule).

rules.msg: `provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection()` was renamed when zoneless went stable in Angular 20.
rules.fix: Call `provideZonelessChangeDetection()`.

rules.msg: `TestBed.flushEffects()` has been deprecated since Angular 20.
rules.fix: Call `TestBed.tick()` — it flushes effects and runs change detection.
